dhp116:1: Let a man make haste to do good; let him restrain his heart from evil;
dhp116:3: For if a man is slow in doing good, his mind delights in evil.
dhp117:1: Should a man commit sin, he should not repeat his sin again and again;
dhp117:3: He should not seek after evil; suffering is the outcome of evil.
dhp118:1: If a man do works of merit, he should do them again and again;
dhp118:3: He should long to do works of merit; happy is the outcome of works of merit.
dhp119:1: Even an evildoer sees happiness, so long as his evil deed has not yet ripened;
dhp119:3: But so soon as his evil deed has ripened, then the evildoer sees evil things.
dhp120:1: Even a good man sees evil, so long as his good deeds have not yet ripened;
dhp120:3: But so soon as his good deeds have ripened, then the good man sees happiness.
dhp121:1: One should not think lightly of evil and say, “It will not come nigh unto me.’
dhp121:3: Even a water-vessel is filled by the falling of one drop of water after another;
dhp121:5: Even so the simpleton fills himself with evil, though he gather it little by little.
dhp122:1: One should not think lightly of good and say, “It will not come nigh unto me.”
dhp122:4: Even a water-vessel is filled by the falling of one drop after another;
dhp123:1: Even as a merchant possessing small company and great wealth avoids a path where danger lurks,
dhp123:3: Even as a man desiring to live avoids poison, so should a man avoid evil.
dhp124:1: If in his hand there be no wound,
dhp124:2: A man may carry poison in his hand.
dhp124:3: Poison cannot harm him who is free from wounds.
dhp124:4: No evil befalls him who does no evil.
dhp125:1: Whosoever commits offense against the man that is offenseless,
dhp125:2: Against the man that is free from impurity and sin,
dhp125:3: Unto that very simpleton returns that evil deed again,
dhp125:4: Like fine dust tossed against the wind.
dhp126:1: Some are reborn on earth, evildoers go to hell,
dhp126:3: The righteous go to heaven, Arahats pass to Nibbāna.
dhp127:1: Neither in the heaven above, nor in the depths of the sea,
dhp127:2: Nor in a cavern of the mountains, should one there enter;
dhp127:3: Nowhere on earth can the place be found
dhp127:4: Where a man can escape from the consequences of an evil deed.
dhp128:1: Neither in the heaven above, nor in the depths of the sea,
dhp128:2: Nor in a cavern of the mountains, should one there enter;
dhp128:3: Nowhere on the earth can the place be found
dhp128:4: Where, if a man abide, Death would not overpower him.
